scouting_result.scout_verdict:
Your history of team-based play has instilled in you a unique ability to read a pack and sense the tactical flow of a race—a skill that defines the Road Machine. Standing at 165cm and 60kg, you possess an exceptional power-to-weight ratio that allows you to sustain high-cadence outputs, transitioning the instinctive coordination you honed in club environments into a singular, relentless performance. Your background in reactive play serves as the foundation for your mental endurance, allowing you to stay sharp when the pack is at its most chaotic.

In the adaptive realm of handcycling, specifically the H3 classification for athletes with lower-limb impairments who compete using a hand-cranked cycle, your capacity for steady, high-intensity exertion is paramount. This pathway demands not only physical output but the same strategic team-reading skills you have always relied upon, now applied to the individual pursuit of finding the perfect draft or gap in a peloton. Whether navigating a technical circuit or driving through a long flat, your potential to deliver a breakthrough performance at The Brisbane 2032 Games is anchored in your ability to maintain focus through the most grueling phases of the race.

The Mat Technician archetype is the mirror to your love for chaos; it thrives on the instinctive, high-stakes reactions that have defined your sporting journey. Where your endurance pathways test your persistence, this profile taps into the explosive, dense physical mechanics you possess. Your compact 165cm, 60kg build acts as a perfectly balanced lever, granting you a distinct advantage in combat and strength scenarios where center of gravity and reactive speed are everything. You are no longer just reacting to team play—you are dictating the physical reality of your opponent.

In your adaptive pathway of powerlifting, specifically within the -67 kg category where athletes compete based on body weight class, this precision is your greatest asset. You apply the meticulous, rule-driven mindset of a long-time club athlete to the technical execution of the lifts, transforming the 'chaotic' energy of your earlier team years into focused, controlled power. Stepping onto the stage at The LA28 Games, you will be the athlete who brings the tactical mind of a strategist to the raw intensity of the iron, proving that your transition from team environments has made you the most formidable competitor in the room.
